issues.issue: The whole printed budget of the General Fund 'Other' line (301,000) is put on the 498,751 Charges for Services piece of the split; the Interest Income and Miscellaneous pieces get null. The same applies to the Road/Bridge Sinking split (detail[38], budget 5,713,340 on the 86,213 Public Works piece) and the Economic Development split (detail[56], budget 122,960). All are marked computed, but budget-vs-actual comparisons for these split pieces don't mean anything.
A General Government line printed 'Miscellaneous' is a catch-all, not a department total, so 'miscellaneous expenditure' might fit better than 'not itemized'. This is a judgment call.
